text: At this time the model has not identified any specific changes that are guaranteed to switch the decision for you. That means there isn’t a single, verified step that will automatically move you into a higher‑risk category. Nevertheless, lenders generally look for a stronger overall financial picture. You can work on reducing the total amount you owe across all accounts, keep any existing credit lines open and in good standing, and make sure your income remains steady and well documented. Adding a reliable source of income or increasing your savings can also help demonstrate repayment ability. While none of these actions are formally verified to change the model’s outcome, they are common ways to improve a credit profile and increase the chance of approval.
